cohort: 117 dichorionic twin pregnancies affected by preeclampsia
finding: Dichorionic twin pregnancies affected by preeclampsia are associated with more placental inflammatory abnormalities if conceived with IVF versus unassisted.
mod_finding: This study did not directly compare modes of delivery but found that dichorionic twin pregnancies affected by preeclampsia and conceived with IVF had more placental inflammatory abnormalities than those conceived unassisted.
